blocks.text: Many jobs require at least basic digital skills, so people without technology or the internet find it harder to get work, raising unemployment in disadvantaged communities. In Pakistan, online job portals and digital banking are often limited to urban areas, widening the urban-rural economic gap.

blocks.prompt: Give one way the digital divide widens economic gaps.
blocks.explanation: People without internet cannot apply through online job portals or use digital banking, so they miss jobs and financial services.

items: Economic disparities: no digital access means fewer jobs and financial services.
